text:
📍 Cretto di Burri, Sicily, Italy 🇮🇹 

This vast white concrete artwork covers the ruins of Gibellina, destroyed by an earthquake in 1968. 
Its maze-like paths turn a devastated town into a striking memorial. 

Would you walk through this unique landscape?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Sicily

📍Perito Moreno Glacier, Patagonia, Argentina 🇦🇷

Walls of blue ice stretch across Lake Argentino, with massive chunks occasionally breaking off into the water.

This remarkable glacier is one of Patagonia’s most spectacular sights.

Would you see it up close?
#Travel #TravelPhotography #Patagonia

📍 Cap de Formentor, Mallorca, Spain 🇪🇸

Dramatic limestone cliffs plunge into deep blue Mediterranean waters at Mallorca’s rugged northern tip.

Winding roads reveal breathtaking coastal views at every turn.

Would you take this scenic drive?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Mallorca

📍 Río Celeste Waterfall, Costa Rica 🇨🇷

Brilliant turquoise water plunges into a rainforest pool inside Tenorio Volcano National Park.

Its striking colour comes from light scattering off suspended minerals.

Would you hike through the rainforest to see it?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #CostaRica

text:
📍 Louvre Museum, Paris, France 🇫🇷

The iconic glass pyramid stands before a former royal palace housing thousands of artworks, including the Mona Lisa.

History and modern architecture meet in the heart of Paris.

Would you explore its galleries?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Paris

📍 Miraflores, Lima, Peru 🇵🇪

Dramatic cliffs overlook the Pacific Ocean, while green coastal parks and scenic promenades line the shore. 

This lively district offers some of Lima’s best ocean views.

Would you watch the sunset here?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Lima #Peru

📍 Uilebomen, The Hague, Netherlands 🇳🇱

Modern high-rises and geometric apartment blocks shape this evolving urban neighbourhood.

The mix of clean lines and dense city architecture offers a different side of The Hague.

Would you live here?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #TheHague #Netherlands

📍 Háifoss & Granni, Iceland 🇮🇸

Two spectacular waterfalls plunge into a rugged volcanic canyon in Iceland’s central highlands.

Háifoss drops an impressive 122 metres, while Granni cascades beside it.

Would you visit this remote landscape?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Iceland

📍 Gran Sasso d'Italia, Abruzzo, Italy 🇮🇹

Rugged limestone peaks rise above vast alpine meadows, creating one of the most dramatic mountain landscapes in the Apennines.

Corno Grande reaches 2,912 metres. Would you explore these mountains?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Italy

📍 Glenfinnan Viaduct, Scotland 🏴

This elegant curved railway bridge crosses a green Highland valley, made famous by the Harry Potter films.

Steam trains still travel across its 21 arches.

Would you watch the train pass?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Scotland

📍 Cerro Mime, Patagonia, Argentina 🇦🇷

Rugged mountain peaks rise above vast Patagonian landscapes, where dramatic rock formations meet open skies.

A striking destination for anyone drawn to remote mountain scenery. 

Would you explore this wilderness?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Patagonia

📍 Fjaðrárgljúfur Canyon, Iceland 🇮🇸

Towering cliffs frame a winding river far below, creating one of Iceland’s most enchanting landscapes.

Carved by glacial meltwater over thousands of years, this canyon is unforgettable.

Would you hike along its rim?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Iceland
